# FlushKeys <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Keyboard](BlitzBasic-Keyboard)

</div>


```blitzbasic
FlushKeys:Void
```

## Description

Throws away everything the keyboard has recorded so far: the queue of typed characters that [GetKey](GetKey) hands out, the keys counted as held for [KeyDown](KeyDown) and the presses counted for [KeyHit](KeyHit). Call it once before a screen that waits for input, such as a menu or a new level, so that button mashing from the previous screen does not skip it. Do not call it every frame, or the program will never see a key.

## Differences

* The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one keyboard.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Text 10, 10, "Mash the keys for a moment..."
Flip
Delay 2000
FlushKeys
Cls
Text 10, 10, "Everything typed so far is forgotten."
Text 10, 30, "Press any key to leave."
Flip
WaitKey
```
